card.name: Partway through SYNDROME and vial words
card.fires_on: The negative pole responds to the "ND" inside the capitalized heading SYNDROME in opioid warning lists, and to "vial" or "vials" after a partial word "v". It weakly appears on a few ordinary words like "seen" or "groups" in news text.

modes.label: SYNDROME in headings
modes.description: The "ND" piece in NEONATAL OPIOID WITHDRAWAL SYNDROME in boxed warning lists.
modes.example: ACCIDENTAL EXPOSURE; NEONATAL OPIOID WITHDRAWAL SY<<ND>>ROME; and RISKS FROM CON

modes.label: Vial after v
modes.description: The ending of the word vial or vials once split after "v", in dosing and injection text.

modes.label: Scattered news words
modes.description: Occasional ordinary words in news prose, such as seen or groups.
modes.example: the agency gave conservative<< groups>> applying for tax-exempt status.
